answer1.answer: If you pour salt on the slug in the image, it would have a negative impact on the slug's health and well-being. This dehydration can cause the slug's body to shrivel up and eventually die. It is important to note that slugs play a crucial role in the ecosystem, as they help break down organic matter and recycle nutrients back into the soil. It is generally considered inhumane to pour salt on slugs or any living creatures as it causes them significant suffering.
